title: EconECPE ECPE annotation output
description: Output schema for emotion-cause pair extraction on a single r/economics comment. One object per comment. A comment with no economically-caused emotion gets pairs: []. Authoritative prose rules live in annotation_spec.md (same version).

emotion.description: Finance-affect label. 'neutral' is not a pair emotion: neutral comments emit no pairs.

emotion_span.description: Verbatim substring of the COMMENT expressing the emotion (minimal but complete).

cause_span.description: Verbatim substring of the comment or its context (post title/selftext, parent comment) stating the cause. null iff no cause is identifiable (then cause_category must be 'unclear').

cause_source.description: Where cause_span was copied from. null iff cause_span is null.

cause_category.description: Fixed cause taxonomy. 'interpersonal' = affect at other users/mods/the sub, not an economic condition (captured, filtered out of market aggregation downstream); 'other' = identifiable economic cause outside the taxonomy; 'unclear' = no identifiable cause (cause_span null).

target_asset.description: Asset class the emotion is about, if any.

intensity.description: Anchored: 0.25 mild, 0.5 moderate, 0.75 strong, 1.0 extreme (intermediate values allowed).

sarcasm.description: true if the emotion is conveyed through sarcasm/irony (label the INTENDED emotion).
